english_classification.chapter_title: [Concerning the Five] War[s that the] Sons of [Li]ght waged with the Sons] of Darkness.
english_classification.chapter_note: The oldest teaching layer is strongly dominant. This chapter preserves a systematic five-fold enumeration mapping five cosmic wars to five principal divinities (First Man, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Splendour, Counsel of Life). The structure is complete and self-contained. Teaching purity is very high (0.842) with minimal editorial fatigue (0.09). The only significant editorial intrusions are: (1) the dialogue frame formula in ¶1, (2) a Gospel citation appended to the first war in ¶2 ('As the saviour has said...'), and (3) a beatitude/exhortation closure in ¶¶8-9. The five-fold enumeration with its systematic cosmic agents, cosmic actions, and cosmic outcomes is classic substrate. Heavy lacunae throughout (especially ¶¶4-5, 7) but the preserved skeleton is clearly correspondential-cosmological.
